title: ?author= empty string silently disables the filter
evidence: app.py:185 `if author:` treats ?author= (empty) as no filter, returning all books rather than books with an empty-string author
suggestion: Use `author is not None` if empty-author filtering should be distinct; current behavior is reasonable for a CRUD toy

title: year validation is asymmetric for negative values
evidence: app.py:114 `_year_is_valid` accepts negative ints (e.g. -500) but rejects the digit-string path for negatives since str.isdigit() is False for '-500'
suggestion: Normalize year parsing if BC/negative years via string input must be supported; not required by the spec

title: list route has no pagination
evidence: app.py:181 list_books returns the full collection unconditionally
suggestion: Not required by TASK.md; note only for cross-run comparison of scope
